text:
The evidence confirms **67.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2020**, but it does not establish whether that loss was deforestation. Tree-cover loss alone does not show whether the land was permanently converted from forest to another use.

For the separate period **2021–2025**, no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected. The tool did record 0.4 ha of loss in smaller patches in 2021. This result does not determine whether the property is deforestation-free or compliant with any regulation.
